benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: The ICICI Emeralde Credit Card is a premium offering that caters to the lifestyle needs of the high-income groups. Though the card now has an upgraded variant in the metal edition—the ICICI Emeralde Private, Emeralde still holds a good return to offer to the consumers who seek overall lifestyle benefits in a single card. Cardholders can earn up to 4 reward points per Rs. 100, including the often excluded transactions like utilities and insurance, free movie tickets via BookMyShow, complimentary golf rounds, shopping vouchers, unlimited lounge access, and much more. In comparison to Emeralde Private and other premium cards like HDFC Diners Club Black, HDFC Infinia, etc., Emeralde offers a very low per-redemption value of Rs. 0.25 and limited redemption options. However, now the launch of the iShop portal has somewhat compensated for this low reward rate. Card users can earn an accelerated 6% reward rate on flights and voucher purchases and 12% on hotel bookings, enhancing the overall value-back potential for frequent shoppers and travelers. If you don’t mind sticking to iShop for your travel bookings and shopping via vouchers, you can easily maximize the reward benefits on the card. But users seeking straightforward reward benefits with a good value-back can consider other options like HDFC Diners Club Black, ICICI Emerald Private, etc.

faqs.q: What is the annual fee waiver condition on this card?
faqs.a: The annual fee of Rs. 12,000 is waived off on annual spends of Rs. 10 Lakh in the previous year.

faqs.q: What is the ICICI credit card customer care number?
faqs.a: The ICICI credit card customer care number is 1860 120 7777.

faqs.q: What is the monthly mode pricing code on the ICICI Emeralde Credit Card?
faqs.a: Apart from the regular annual fee charges, the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card is also available on monthly mode pricing code. Instead of a one-time annual fee, a monthly fee of Rs. 1,000 will be applicable on the card, which will be waived off on spends of Rs. 1 Lakh in the previous month.

faqs.q: Are there any cash withdrawal charges on this card?
faqs.a: The cash withdrawal charge on the ICICI Emeralde credit card is waived. However, in general, withdrawing cash using your credit card is not advisable.

faqs.q: Is there any capping on reward earning on insurance spends?
faqs.a: Yes, you can earn rewards on insurance spends of up to Rs. 80,000 only.

faqs.question: Is the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: The ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card is worth considering if you value premium lifestyle benefits such as unlimited airport lounge access, golf privileges, and the BookMyShow offer. However, if maximizing rewards is your priority, there are better premium credit cards available in this price segment.

faqs.question: What is the reward rate of the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers up to 4 Reward Points per ₹100 spent on retail transactions, translating to an effective reward rate of up to 1%. Utility and insurance transactions earn 1 Reward Point per ₹100, while fuel and government transactions do not earn Reward Points.

faqs.question: Does the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card offer unlimited airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card offers unlimited complimentary domestic and international airport lounge access for the primary cardholder. International lounge access is available through Priority Pass or DreamFolks, depending on the card issuance date.

faqs.question: Does the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card have a forex markup fee?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card charges a 2% forex markup plus applicable GST, making it a competitive option for international spending.

faqs.question: Does the ICICI Bank Emeralde Credit Card offer an annual fee waiver?
faqs.answer: Yes. The annual fee of ₹12,000 + GST is waived if you spend ₹10 lakh or more during the membership year.
